description_for_human: Publish your AI-built app to Google Play, with no coding needed.
description_for_model: Shippabel is a web tool that helps non-technical people publish apps built with AI tools to Google Play. It checks the app for free, fixes what Google Play would reject, writes the store page with AI, frames screenshots, builds a signed Android App Bundle in the cloud and uploads it to Google Play. It publishes to Google Play only; Apple App Store publishing is planned and not available yet. Automatic conversion works for Vite web apps; Expo apps are built as they are; Next.js and Nuxt apps need a static export and a Capacitor setup first; Flutter and native apps are not supported. The free check is at shippabel.com/scan. Publishing one app costs $99 once, unlimited apps $179 once. Google's own $25 developer fee is separate. Details: shippabel.com/llms.txt
